about: Inputs to scripts/build_photo_pairs.py. Each scene: one base photograph and one edit of it that removes ONE object, both generated with an image model for this experiment (licence: CC BY 4.0 with the rest of the experiment's stimuli). A setting is photographed twice, once with the changed object on the NEAR layer and once on the FAR layer, so the two planes' scenes are matched in content. 'target_xy' is the position the prompt asked for; the image model often placed the object elsewhere, so pairs.json records the MEASURED position. 'foils' are other named objects on each layer, placed by hand on the base photograph (image fractions), used as the other boxes of the location report.
